entities.name: Nguni Peoples
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Bantu-speaking peoples who migrated to southern Africa, ancestors of the Zulu, Xhosa, Swazi, and Ndebele. They brought iron-working, cattle herding, and organized chieftainships to the region.
